name: Memory Inject
description: Auto-inject recent memory/*.md files into new sessions so agents have continuity across new threads and /new resets. Lightweight, multi-agent, fail-open.
author: dannyge

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, the plugin loads but performs no injection.

memoryDir.description: Memory directory relative to the agent workspaceDir. Default: 'memory' (resolves to <workspaceDir>/memory).

daysToLoad.description: How many recent days of memory files to consider. Default 2 = today + yesterday.

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of memory files to inject per session. Files beyond this are dropped (newest first by mtime).

maxTokens.description: Soft cap on the total size of injected memory content. Estimated as characters / 4. Files are dropped (oldest first) once the cap is exceeded.

filenamePattern.description: Regular expression matched against each file basename. Files that do not match are ignored. The default matches YYYY-MM-DD.md and YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md.

excludeAgents.description: Agent ids that should never receive memory injection (for example, agents that handle sensitive workloads or already manage their own context loading).

contextLabel.description: Header line prepended to the injected context block. Set empty to omit.
